_: Every faction the world can name, at Morrowind's size. A place's own community is a `localGroups` label on its catalogue record, never a faction here (merge reasons: lanes/2.4/af-merge-map.json). hostility.owner, ownerFaction and every person's faction must resolve here. `standing` per faction and the top-level `rules` are the data that the FactionStanding runtime reads (packages/game-core/src/factions); docs/quests/40-factions.md § Registry and standing.

entries.name: The An-Xileel
entries.notes: The nativist successor administration that governs Argonia in 4E 201 — offices and name inherited from the movement of 4E 6, mandate not.

join.refusal: The state's own administration; it recognises and employs people but offers no ranks to a newcomer (quests/10 political frame).

unstated.*: docs/quests/40-factions.md §28: only the faction lines are joinable, so no player is ever a member to expel; join.refusal says the same
